records.query: NVIDIA 的核心技術護城河是什麼？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 的核心技術護城河在於其 CUDA 平台與廣泛的軟體生態系統，結合 GPU 架構與全棧解決方案，形成難以模仿的加速運算優勢。  

- NVIDIA 的技術堆疊包含基礎的 CUDA 開發平台（可在所有 NVIDIA GPU 上運行），以及數百個特定領域的軟體函式庫、框架、演算法、軟體開發套件（SDK）與應用程式介面（API），這個深闊的軟體堆疊能加速效能並便於部署 AI 模型訓練與推論、資料分析、科學運算等計算密集型工作負載【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- 透過 Blackwell 架構，NVIDIA 的資料中心規模產品實現極致共設計，將晶片、網路、系統、軟體與演算法整體架構與最佳化，以達到最高效能與規模【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- GPU 原本用於模擬人類想像力以創造電子遊戲與電影虛擬世界，現在也模擬人類智慧，其平行處理能力由數萬個運算核心支撐，是深度學習演算法的基礎【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- 這種 AI 形式（軟體透過大量資料學習而自我寫成）可作為電腦、機器人與自駕車的「大腦」，使其能感知、理解與推論世界【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- 成千上萬的企業正利用 GPU 加速的 AI 解決方案開發服務與產品，傳統編碼難以達成或甚至不可能的功能，例如生成式 AI（可產生文字、程式碼、圖像、音訊、影像、分子結構與推薦系統）以及代理人式 AI（多個 AI 模型協同完成任務）【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- NVIDIA 採取平台策略，將硬體、系統、軟體、演算法、函式庫、AI 模型與訓練資料集以及服務結合，為所服務的市場創造獨特價值【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- 面對多樣化的端市場運算需求，NVIDIA 透過統一的可編程底層架構（GPU、網路與軟體堆疊），使用內部或第三方開發的各種軟體堆疊，支援數個價值數十億美元的端市場【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- 平台上龐大且持續成長的開發者社群與已安裝基礎設施進一步強化生態系統，提升平台對客戶的價值【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- 創新是 NVIDIA 的核心，自成立以來已投資超過 767 億美元（$76.7 billion）於研發，累計發明對現代運算至關重要的技術【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- NVIDIA 於 1999 年發明 GPU，帶動 PC 遊戲市場成長並重新定義電腦圖形；2006 年推出 CUDA 開放 GPU 的平行處理能力給廣泛的計算密集應用，為現代 AI 的興起鋪路；2012 年 AlexNet 在 NVIDIA GPU 上訓練贏得 ImageNet 比賽，被視為 AI 的「大爆炸」時刻；2017 年推出首顆 Tensor Core GPU【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- 2025 年度 10-K 亦描述相同的技術堆疊與平台策略：CUDA 程式設計模型、數百個領域特定的軟體庫與 SDK、可擴展至數萬台 GPU 加速伺服器的資料中心解決方案、平行處理由數千個運算核心支撐、數千家企業開發 GPU 加速的 AI 方案（包括生成式 AI）、平台策略帶來獨特價值、統一可編程架構支援多個數十億美元端市場、開發者與安裝基礎持續增長、自成立以來研發投資超過 582 億美元（$58.2 billion）、GPU 發明、CUDA 推出、AlexNet 里程碑與首顆 Tensor Core GPU【NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #19】。  
- 此外，NVIDIA 指出自原始 PC 圖形焦點擴展至科學運算、AI、資料科學、自動駕駛、機器人與數位雙胞胎等大型計算密集領域，憑藉 GPU 架構建構相應平台，現在已成為重塑所有產業的資料中心規模 AI 基礎設施公司【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #120】；相同敘述亦見於 2026 年 10-Q（四月）【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #40】與 2025 年 10-Q（十月）【NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #45】。

records.query: NVIDIA 如何用同一套底層架構同時佈局資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用市場？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 透過以 GPU 為核心、CUDA 為基礎的統一硬體與軟體平台，再依據不同市場的需求搭配專屬的軟體堆疊與優化，同時服務資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用四大市場。  

NVIDIA 的平台涵蓋四大核心市場：資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與汽車（Automotive）[NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #22]，亦在 2026 年度報告中再次確認這四大市場[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24]。這些平台由處理器、互連、軟體、演算法、系統與服務組成，以提供獨特價值[NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #22]，同樣在 2026 年度報告中所述[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24]。儘管這些終端市場的運算需求各異，NVIDIA 透過統一的底層架構——利用其 GPU、網路與軟體堆疊——來滿足它們[NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #19]。更進一步說明，這個統一且可程式化的架構使公司能够在相同的基礎技術上支援數個多十億美元的終端市場，僅需透過內部或第三方開發者提供的各種軟體堆疊來進行適配[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。因此，NVIDIA 能以同一套 GPU‑CUDA 基礎平台，藉由不同的軟體與域特定優化，同時佈局資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用等多元市場。

Microsoft 透過將 Windows 商業版的雲端部分納入 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端收入的組成項目，同時將 Microsoft 365 Copilot 列為該訂閱的一部分，從而在同一訂閱框架下帶動雲端服務與 Copilot 相關服務的使用。[MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #12][MSFT_10Q_202412.html, chunk #10]  

具體來看，Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue growth 這項指標所涵蓋的收入來源包括：Microsoft 365 Commercial 訂閱、Enterprise Mobility + Security、Windows Commercial 的雲端部分、Power BI 的 per-user 部分、Exchange、SharePoint、Microsoft Teams、Microsoft 365 Security and Compliance、以及 Microsoft 365 Copilot。[MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #12][MSFT_10Q_202412.html, chunk #10]  

因此，當客戶訂閱或使用包含 Windows Commercial 雲端部分的 Microsoft 365 Commercial 服務時，亦會同時獲得該訂閱所涵蓋的 Microsoft 365 Copilot 使用權，進而間接提升雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度。[MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #12][MSFT_10Q_202412.html, chunk #10]

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 領域（含與 Anthropic 的合作）的投資策略是什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon 透過持續加大 AWS 基礎設施與 AI/ML 投資，並透過與 Anthropic 的股權投資與融資安排來佈局生成式 AI，同時擴大衛星網路與自駕車等新興業務，以提升客戶體驗與流程效率。  

- Amazon 在多個技術與基礎設施領域尋求高效投資，包括 AWS、新舊產品與服務的擴張，以及提升客戶體驗和改善流程效率的基礎設施[AMZN_10K_2024.html, chunk #97]。  
- Amazon 投資於 AWS，提供計算、儲存、資料庫、分析和機器學習等廣泛的隨選技術服務，面向各規模的開發者與企業[AMZN_10K_2024.html, chunk #97]。  
- Amazon 亦投資於建置與部署創新且高效的軟體與電子設備、全球寬頻衛星網路以及叫車服務的自駕車[AMZN_10K_2024.html, chunk #97]。  
- 技術與基礎設施成本包含研發員工的薪資與相關費用、門市開發與維護、線上商店的產品策展與展示，以及伺服器、網路設備、資料中心折舊與攤銷、租金、公用事業等支出[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #79]。  
- Amazon 致力於在眾多技術與基礎設施領域高效投資，以透過快速技術發展提升客戶體驗與流程效率，同時規模持續擴大[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #79]。  
- 技術與基礎設施的投資與資本支出項目常因地理擴張與系統跨功能性而支援多種產品與服務[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #79]。  
- Amazon 預期技術與基礎設施支出將隨著基礎設施與員工增加而持續上升，特別是為支援人工智慧與機器學習計畫[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #79]。  
- 2025 年度技術與基礎設施成本增加主要來自基礎設施支出（含折舊與攤銷）的上升，匯率變動當年增加成本 3.12 億美元（$312 百萬）[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #119]。  
- Amazon 目前將全球寬頻衛星網路開發相關的大部分成本（生產、發射、薪資及發射時的訂金）列為費用；一旦服務達到商業可行性，將對其中部分成本進行資本化，包括對客戶的銷售[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #119]。  
- 在 2026 年 3 月 31 日之後，Amazon 投資 $5.0 億美元於 Anthropic 的非投票優先股[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #38]。  
- 2026 年第二季，Amazon 投資 $5.0 億美元於 Anthropic Series G 非投票優先股；同時行使選權投資 $5.0 億美元於 Anthropic Series H 非投票優先股，使該融資額度剩餘 $15.0 億美元[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #39]。  
- Amazon 與 Anthropic 訂立融資安排，提供最高不超過 $20.0 億美元的額度，該額度將在 Anthropic 發生流動性事件（包括 IPO）後 30 個月到期；起初無法提款，隨著在修訂後的商業安排下達到特定計算容量里程碑，額度將依 Anthropic 需求開放提款，提款形式為新發行的 Anthropic 可轉換票據，或在 IPO/其他流動性事件後（受持股上限限制）發行 Anthropic 普通股作為現金交換[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #39]。  
- 2026 年第二季，Amazon 記錄約 505 億美元（$50.5 billion）的非投票優先股向上調整；截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止六個月，累計向上調整約 628 億美元（$62.8 billion），計入「其他收入（支出），淨額」以反映 Anthropic 融資的可觀察價格變動[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #39]。  
- 於 2025 年 12 月 31 日與 2026 年 6 月 30 日，Amazon 合併資產負債表中記錄的非投票優先股金額約為 148 億美元（$14.8 billion）與 925 億美元（$92.5 billion）；同期間，可轉換票據的估計公平價值約為 458 億美元（$45.8 billion）與 979 億美元（$97.9 billion），其對應的未實現利益（計入「其他綜合損益」）約為 395 億美元（$39.5 billion）與 $92.0 億美元[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #39]。  

以上為根據提供之參考資料所能說明的 Amazon 在 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 領域（含與 Anthropic 合作）的投資策略。

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨哪些反壟斷或監管風險？
records.answer:
Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨的反壟斷或監管風險主要包括：對其線上商店（含履約網路與 Prime）及 AWS 雲端服務的競爭與消費者保護相關調查、義大利的稅務與其他挑戰、私人訴訟與政府機關指控的價格固定、壟斷、試圖壟斷及消費者保護不當得利主張，以及 Xockets 對 AWS Nitro 系統的專利侵權訴訟。  

- 亞馬遜面臨多項公開調查，指控其營運違反競爭或消費者保護規則，具體涉及其線上商店的運營（包括履約網路與 Prime）以及 AWS 雲端服務的某些方面【AMZN_10K_2024.html, chunk #80】。  
- 同樣的說法亦出現在 2025 年度 10-K 報告中，指出存在基於競爭相關或消費者保護規則的公開調查，涉及線上商店（含履約網路與 Prime）及 AWS 的某些雲端服務【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #81】。  
- 2026 年第一季 10-Q 報告再次提及，除了義大利的稅務與其他挑戰外，亦面臨基於競爭相關或消費者保護規則的公開調查，涉及線上商店（含履約網路與 Prime）及 AWS 的某些雲端服務【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #124】。  
- 2026 年第二季 10-Q 報告重複上述義大利稅務與其他挑戰，並重申存在基於競爭相關或消費者保護規則的公開調查，涉及線上商店（含履約網路與 Prime）及 AWS 的某些雲端服務【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #125】。  
- 自 2020 年 3 月以來，私人原告、各州檢察長及美國聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）已在美国、加拿大及英國提起訴訟，指控亞馬遜與其供應商及第三方賣家存在價格固定安排；涉及支配地位濫用、壟斷及試圖壟斷；以及消費者保護和不當得利主張【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #45】。  
- 部分訴訟進一步指控亞馬遜在線上超級商店、市場服務或中介服務市場擁有壟斷地位，並透過定價政策、精選商品（Featured Offers）選賣、賣家資料使用、廣告做法、Prime 結構以及自營產品推廣從事反競爭行為【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #45】。  
- 2025 年 6 月，Xockets, Inc. 在美國得克薩斯州西區地方法院對亞馬遜及 AWS 提出兩項訴訟，指控某些版本的 AWS Nitro 系統侵害其美國專利號 11,080,209；10,649,924；11,082,350；10,223,297；9,378,161；9,436,640；以及 10,212,092【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #45】。  

以上即為參考資料中所描述的亞馬遜在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨的主要反壟斷或監管風險。

records.query: Google 如何把 Gemini AI 整合進搜尋與其他產品生態系？
records.answer:
Google 透過將 Gemini 模型嵌入搜尋、YouTube、廣告、工作空間、Android、Chrome 等產品，並提供 AI Overviews、NotebookLM、Gemini 應用程式等功能，將 Gemini AI 整合進其產品生態系。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128] 目前有 15 款半億用戶產品（其中 7 款擁有 20 億用戶）都在使用 Gemini 模型。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128] 具體而言，Gemini 3 透過增強的推理能力支援視覺化與互動體驗，適用於搜尋與 Gemini 應用程式。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128] 在搜尋方面，AI Overviews 讓使用者能提出複雜問題、將概念分解或對影片提出口頭問題；NotebookLM 則協助使用者透過摘要來源與提供相關引用來理解複雜資訊。[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #135] 對於 YouTube，Google 利用 Gemini 改進推薦系統。[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #135] 在廣告端，廣告商可使用 Google Ads 中的更新圖像生成功能產出高品質活動圖像。[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #135] Gemini 應用程式提供圖像生成、程式碼支援與應用程式整合等新功能，讓使用者得以協作。[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #135] 針對工作空間，Gemini for Google Workspace 帶來 AI 驅動的代理，進入 Gmail、Docs、Sheets 等應用，協助使用者寫作、組織、視覺化、加速工作流程並進行更豐富的會議。[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #135] 此外，Google Cloud 的 Vertex AI 平台讓開發者能使用 Gemini、Imagen、Veo 等生成式 AI 模型進行訓練、調整、擴充、測試與部署；Gemini for Google Cloud 提供預先封裝的 AI 代理，協助開發者編寫、文件撰寫、測試、操作軟體，也支援網路安全團隊進行威脅偵測與回應。[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #135] 更廣泛地，Gemini 已成為 Android、Chrome、Gmail、Maps、Play Store、Search 與 YouTube 這七款擁有 20 億用戶產品的核心 AI 功能。[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #131] Google Cloud 平台與 Google Workspace 則透過 AI 優化基礎設施、開發平台、世界級模型以及輔助代理與應用，幫助組織保持創新前沿。[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #131] 在資料與分析層面，Google 提供多種資料庫（關聯式、鍵值、記憶體內）來儲存與管理資料，並將資料湖、資料倉儲、資料治理與進階機器學習統一於單一平台，以便使用 AI 模型進行跨雲端資料分析。[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #140] 最後，Google Workspace 原本已透過 Smart Reply、Smart Compose 以及 Gmail 中的惡意程式與釣魚防護等功能運用 AI 來提升語法、效率與安全；現在 Gemini for Google Workspace 將 AI 驅動的代理引入 Gmail、Docs、Sheets 等應用，進一步協助使用者寫作、組織、視覺化、加速工作流程並擁有更豐富的會議。[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #140]

records.query: Google 搜尋如何演變出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 來回應生成式 AI 對搜尋的衝擊？
records.answer:
Google Search 透過引入大型語言模型與 Gemini，演變出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode，以更自然的語言查詢和多模態、細膩的回應來應對生成式 AI 對搜尋的衝擊。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132][GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #137]

- Google Search 最早是以十個藍色連結的網頁搜尋起步，之後經過行動網頁搜尋、Universal Search（可同時搜尋新聞、圖片、影片等）、語音與視覺搜尋、以及 Multisearch（文字＋圖片同時搜尋）等技術進步，逐漸成為動態、多模態的體驗。[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #137]  
- 大型語言模型的出現使使用者能以更自然的語言提出問題，顯著提升查詢類型與結果品質。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]  
- 基於此，Google 現在使用為 Google Search 客製化的 Gemini，提供改進的搜尋體驗，並推出 AI Overviews，該功能已在超過一百個國家上線，觸及超過十億使用者。[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #137]  
- 另一項創新是 AI Mode，它讓使用者能提出過去可能需要多次搜尋才能獲得答案的較為微細的問題，利用 Gemini 的進階推理、思考及多模態能力來回答。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]  
- 這些改變都是出於讓資訊更易於存取且更具幫助性的目標，進而提升網路及 Google Play、YouTube 等平台上的數位內容探索與創造。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132][GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #137]

Meta 的長期願景是把元宇宙（an embodied internet where people have immersive experiences beyond two-dimensional screens）打造成下一代社交技術與運算平台，並透過在 AI、可穿戴裝置與裝置上的創新來建構下一代介面。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165]  
該公司於 2021 年宣布將業務與產品策略轉向協助實現元宇宙，並將重點放在 AI、可穿戴裝置與裝置的創新，以建構下一代介面。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165]  
Meta 預計這將是一項複雜、演變且長期的舉措，將涉及新興技術的開發、基礎設施的持續投資，以及隱私、安全與安全工作的加強，並與其他公司、開發者、合作夥伴及其他參與者合作。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165]  
公司會定期評估產品路線圖，並根據對技術挑戰、市場環境以及產品構想與設計的理解變化而做出重大調整。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165]  
由於在消費者硬體與虛擬/擴增實境技術方面經驗相對有限，其他公司可能因此更有效地競爭。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165]  
Meta 可能在研究與產品開發上失敗，特別是若無法與元宇宙關鍵參與者建立關係，或無法開發出能與元宇宙技術、產品、系統、網路或標準有效運作的產品。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165]  
例如，部分消費者硬體產品依賴於與第三方行動平台的互操作性，而這些平台未必提供與其自家競爭產品同等的互操作性。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165]  
Reality Labs 的工作也可能佔用資源與管理層的注意力，影響其他業務領域。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165]  
Meta 預計將繼續在虛擬實境、擴增實境及其他技術上進行重大投資，並且能否支持這些投資取決於其他業務所產生的足夠利潤。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165]  
隨著 Reality Labs 的發展，公司可能面臨美國及國際各地現有或新興法律與規範的影響，包括隱私、安全、AI、競爭、內容規範、醫療器械、關稅、出口管制、消費者保護與電子商務等領域，這可能延誤或阻礙產品與服務的開發、增加營運成本、佔用大量管理時間與注意力，或以其他方式傷害業務。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165]  
因此，Reality Labs 的策略與投資在可見未來甚至完全不成功的風險存在，可能對業務、聲譽或財務結果造成不利影響。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165]  
若無法維持與提升品牌，將可能削弱維持或擴大使用者、行銷商與開發者基礎的能力，進而損害業務與財務表現。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165]  
Meta 的使命是建構人類連接的未來及使之成為可能的技術，其產品讓人們能透過行動裝置、個人電腦、VR/MR 耳機、AR 與可穿戴裝置連結與分享。[META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21]  
公司正將產品從 2D 螢幕移向增強實境、混合實境與虛擬實境等沉浸式體驗，以協助構建下一代運算平台。[META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21]  
Meta 的願景不聚焦於單一產品，而是構建一整套體驗、裝置與新技術的生態系統；相信元宇宙將成為下一代運算平台與未來的社交互動方式。[META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21]  
在全體工作中，Meta 正在人工智慧（AI）領域進行創新，以打造讓平台更具社交性、實用性與沉浸感的新體驗。[META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21]  
Meta 的 AI 投資支撐產品與服務的多項舉措，包括協助為應用程式內容排名的系統、推薦相關內容的探索引擎、廣告主用來觸達客戶的工具、新一代生成式 AI 體驗的開發，以及提升產品開發效率與生產力的工具。[META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21]  
例如，Meta AI 是一個可在公司應用程式、Ray‑Ban Meta AI 眼鏡以及網路上使用的助理，旨在協助人們學習、完成任務、創作內容並與他人連結，以充分利用每一刻。[META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21]  
Meta 按兩大業務分部報告財務結果：Family of Apps（FoA）與 Reality Labs（RL）。目前，公司絕大部分收入來自於在 Family of Apps 上向行銷商販售廣告位置；RL 則透過銷售消費者硬體產品、軟體與內容產生收入。[META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21]  
Meta 正持續增加對 AI 模型開發與訓練的投資，並同時加大在新平台與技術上的投資，包括 VR、Horizon 與可穿戴裝置等領域。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67]  
其中，對 Reality Labs 的重大投資僅帶來有限收入，並降低了營運邊際與盈利能力；預計此類投資的不利財務影響將在可見未來持續。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67]  
具體而言，2025 年 Reality Labs 的投資使公司整體營運利潤減少約 191.9 億美元（$19.19 billion），且預計 2026 年 Reality Labs 的營運虧損將與 2025 年相近。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67]  
若這些投資無法在長期內取得成功，將可能損害公司的業務與財務表現。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67]

[META 10-Q period 202603] We may not be successful in our Reality Labs strategy and investments, which could adversely affect our business, reputation, or financial results. We believe the metaverse, an embodied internet where people have immersive experiences beyond two-dimensional screens, is the next evolution in social technology. In 2021, we announced a shift in our business and product strategy to focus on helping to bring the metaverse to life, and we are directing our efforts toward innovations in AI, wearables, and devices to help build next-generation interfaces. We expect this will be a complex, evolving, and long-term initiative that will involve the development of new and emerging technologies, continued investment in infrastructure as well as privacy, safety, and security efforts, and collaboration with other companies, developers, partners, and other participants. However, the metaverse may not develop in accordance with our expectations, and market acceptance of features, products, or services we build is uncertain. We regularly evaluate our product roadmaps and make significant changes as our understanding of the technological challenges and market landscape and our product ideas and designs evolve. In addition, we have relatively limited experience with consumer hardware products and virtual and augmented reality technology, which may enable other companies to compete more effectively than us. We may be unsuccessful in our research and product development efforts, including if we are unable to develop relationships with key participants in the metaverse or develop products that operate effectively with metaverse technologies, products, systems, networks, or standards. For example, some of our consumer hardware products depend on the ability to operate with third-party mobile platforms and these platforms do not necessarily provide our products with the same levels of interoperability that they provide to their own competing products. In addition, our Reality Labs efforts may also divert resources and management attention from other areas of our business. We expect to continue to make significant investments in virtual and augmented reality and other technologies to support these efforts, and our ability to support these efforts is dependent on generating sufficient profits from other areas of our business. Overview

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. We build technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses. Our products enable people to connect and share with friends and family through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) and mixed reality (MR) headsets, augmented reality (AR), and wearables. We also help people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, enable people to share their experiences, ideas, photos, videos, and other content with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing our products. Meta is moving our offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented, mixed, and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform. Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies. While the metaverse is in the very early stages of its development, we believe it will become the next computing platform and the future of social interaction. Across our work, we are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build new experiences that help make our platform more social, useful, and immersive. Our AI investments support initiatives across our products and services, helping power the systems that rank content in our apps, our discovery engine that recommends relevant content, the tools advertisers use to reach customers, the development of new generative AI experiences, and the tools that make our product development more efficient and productive. For example, Meta AI is an assistant that's available across our apps, on Ray-Ban Meta AI glasses and on the web. It's designed to help people learn, get things done, create content, and connect with others to make the most of every moment. We report financial results for two segments: Family of Apps (FoA) and Reality Labs (RL). Currently, we generate substantially all of our revenue from selling advertising placements on our family of apps to marketers, which is reflected in FoA. Ads on our platform enable marketers to reach people across a range of marketing objectives, such as generating leads or driving awareness. Marketers purchase ads that can appear in multiple places including on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and third-party applications and websites. RL generates revenue from sales of consumer hardware products, software, and content.

records.query: Meta 的廣告獲利模式與 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中扮演的角色是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 透過在 Family of Apps 中販售廣告位置來產生主要收入，並以總廣告收入除以廣告投放次數計算每則廣告的平均價格來衡量廣告獲利，同時將 Meta AI 定位為跨應用的智慧助理，協助使用者學習、完成任務、創作內容並提升廣告定位與產品開發效率【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】。  

具體來說，Meta 的廣告收入是以「總廣告收入 ÷ 廣告投放次數」得出的平均每則廣告價格來衡量，這個平均價格代表廣告主不管是以曝光還是互動為目標所願意支付的每則廣告費用；當 Meta 不是廣告交易的主要方時，會以淨基礎確認收入【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】。除了廣告之外，其他收入來源包括 WhatsApp 的付費訊息、Meta Verified 訂閱以及各種其他來源的收入【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】。  

至於 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中的角色，它被設計為一個可在所有應用內、獨立應用、AI 眼鏡以及網頁上使用的助理，目的在協助人們學習、完成任務、創作內容並與他人連結，以充分利用每一刻【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。Meta 的 AI 投資同時為產品和服務提供動力，包括：負責在 App 中排名內容的系統、推薦相關內容的探索引擎、廣告主用來觸達客戶的工具、新一代生成式 AI 體驗的開發，以及提升產品開發效率的工具【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21】。此外，Meta AI 也被整合到可穿戴裝置中，例如 Ray‑Ban Meta AI 眼鏡，該眼鏡具備 Meta AI 這項先進的對話式助理以及免手操作等功能【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #24】。這些說明均來自所提供的參考資料。

--- Business Summary --- Meta Platforms, Inc. engages in the development of products that enable people to connect and share with friends and family through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses in the United States, Canada, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Family of Apps (FoA) and Reality Labs (RL). The FoA segment offers Facebook, which enables people to build community through feed, reels, stories, groups, marketplace, and other; Instagram that brings people closer through Instagram feed, stories, reels, live, and messaging; Messenger, a messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls; Meta AI, an assistant that's available across apps, as a stand-alone app, on AI glasses, and on the web; Threads, an application for text-based updates and public conversations; and WhatsApp, a messaging application that is used by people and businesses to communicate and transact. The RL segment provides virtual and augmented reality products, including consumer hardware, software, and content that help people feel connected, as well as Meta Quest devices that enable social experiences across gaming, fitness, entertainment, and more. The segment also includes wearables such as AI glasses like Ray Ban Meta and Oakley Meta glasses; and the Meta Ray Ban Display, which combines AI glasses with an integrated lens display and the Meta Neural Band, a wrist worn device using electromyography that lets people control their AI glasses through neuromuscular signals. [META 10-K period 2025] Item 1.Business 

Overview

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. Our products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses. We are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across our Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance our vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone. We build technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses. We also help people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, enable people to share their experiences, ideas, photos, videos, and other content with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing our products. Meta is moving our offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform. Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies powered by AI. While the metaverse is in the very early stages of its development, we believe it will become the next computing platform and the future of social interaction. Across our work, we are innovating to build new experiences that help make our platform more social, useful, and immersive. Our AI investments support initiatives across our products and services, helping power the systems that rank content in our apps, our discovery engine that recommends relevant content, the tools advertisers use to reach customers, the development of new generative AI experiences, and the tools that make our product development more efficient and productive. We are also working to develop the next generation of AI models and advance our vision to build superintelligence, which we define as AI that surpasses human intelligence. Although it is inherently difficult to predict when superintelligence may be achieved, we are investing now because we believe this has the potential to begin a new era of individual empowerment, where people can direct superintelligence towards what they value in their own lives. Family of Apps Products

•Facebook. Facebook helps give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together. It's a place for people to share life's moments and discuss what's happening, nurture and build relationships, discover and connect to people with shared interests, and create economic opportunity. They can do this through Feed, Reels, Stories, Groups, Marketplace, and more. •Instagram. Instagram brings people closer to the people and things they love. Instagram Feed, Stories, Reels, Live, and messaging are places where people and creators can connect and express themselves through photos, video, and private messaging, and discover and shop from their favorite businesses. •Messenger. Messenger is a simple yet powerful messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls. •Meta AI. Meta AI is an assistant that's available across our apps, as a stand-alone app, on our AI glasses, and on the web. It's designed to help people learn, get things done, create content, and connect with others to make the most of every moment.

[META 10-Q period 202603] [section: Family of Apps (FoA)] The number of ads we show is subject to methodological changes as we continue to evolve our ads business and the structure of our ads products. In particular, the ads we show may vary by product (for example, our video and Reels products are not currently monetized at the same rate as our Feed or Stories products), and from time to time we increase or decrease the number or frequency of ads we show as part of our product and monetization strategies. We calculate average price per ad as total advertising revenue divided by the number of ads delivered, representing the average price paid per ad by a marketer regardless of their desired objective such as impression or action. For advertising revenue arrangements where we are not the principal, we recognize revenue on a net basis.

Other revenue. Other revenue consists of revenue from paid messaging from WhatsApp, Meta Verified subscriptions, and revenue from various other sources.

Currently, we generate substantially all of our revenue from selling advertising placements on our family of apps to marketers, which is reflected in FoA. Ads on our platform enable marketers to reach people across a range of marketing objectives, such as generating leads or driving awareness. Marketers purchase ads that can appear in multiple places including on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and third-party applications and websites. RL generates revenue from sales of consumer hardware products, software, and content.

[META 10-K period 2024] •WhatsApp. WhatsApp is a simple, reliable, and secure messaging application that is used by people and businesses around the world to communicate and transact in a private way. Within WhatsApp we launched WhatsApp Channels, a one-to-many broadcast service designed to help people follow information from people and organizations that are important to them. Reality Labs Products

Many of our Reality Labs investments are directed toward long-term, cutting edge research and development for products that are not on the market today and may only be fully realized in the next decade. This includes exploring new technologies such as neural interfaces using electromyography, which lets people control their devices using neuromuscular signals, as well as innovations in AI and hardware to help build next-generation interfaces. In the near term, we are continuing to develop early metaverse and wearables products and experiences that help people feel connected, anytime, anywhere. Our metaverse efforts include our VR, MR, and social platform initiatives. Our current product offerings in VR include our Meta Quest devices, as well as software and content available through the Meta Horizon Store, which enable a range of social experiences that allow people to defy physical distance while engaging in gaming, fitness, entertainment, and more. To drive greater adoption and acceptance of VR we have introduced MR capabilities, which allow users to experience the immersion and presence of VR while still being grounded in the physical world, through our Meta Quest devices. Our wearables efforts include our AR initiatives. We have continued to advance our roadmap to include additional AI-enabled offerings such as the Ray-Ban Meta AI glasses, which feature Meta AI, our advanced conversational assistant, as well as other features such as hands-free interaction. As we continue our long-term efforts to bring AR glasses to market, in 2024 we also unveiled our Orion prototype, a pair of true AR glasses that overlay content on top of the physical world. It does this with an industry-leading field of view and in glasses form factor for comfortable wear. In general, while all of these investments are part of our long-term initiative to help build the next computing platform, our metaverse efforts also include notable shorter-term projects developing specific products and services to go to market, whereas our wearables efforts are primarily directed toward longer-term research and development projects. For example, in 2025, we expect to spend approximately 50% of our Reality Labs operating expenses on our wearables initiatives, and the remaining 50% on our metaverse initiatives. We apply significant judgment in estimating this expense breakdown as there are certain shared costs across product lines, and our expectations are subject to change, including as the next computing platform and our business strategies evolve. In particular, we regularly evaluate our product roadmaps and make significant changes as our understanding of the technological challenges and market landscape and our product ideas and designs evolve. records.query: Tesla 如何把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術當作與競爭對手的核心差異化？
records.answer:
Tesla 視其自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術為與競爭對手的核心差異化，因為它擁有專屬的視覺 AI、自研晶片、FSD 電腦、持續資料收集與訓練、透過 OTA 軟體更新提升功能、並計畫推出 Robotaxi 服務以及將 AI 應用於機器人（Optimus），這些被公司認為使其在自動駕駛領域領先於競爭對手。  

- Tesla 使用 AI 開發自動駕駛解決方案與機器人應用。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25]  
- 公司採用視覺為基礎的技術、系統與軟體來訓練人工神經網路，並由自行設計的自訂推論晶片加速運算。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25]  
- 特斯拉將自動駕駛的 AI 學習應用於機器人，例如正在開發的通用自動人形機器人 Optimus。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25]  
- 車輛內提供進階駕駛輔助系統（Autopilot/FSD），儘管駕駛員仍需全程專注，但系統可提供安全與便利功能，減少駕駛中的繁瑣與危險。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25]  
- 特斯拉透過空中下載（OTA）軟體更新持續改進車輛的自動駕駛功能。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25]  
- 每輛今天交付的特斯拉車輛皆被設計為具備自動駕駛能力。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25]  
- 公司相信其在 AI 與自動駕駛方面的能力與進步使其區別於競爭對手。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25]  
- 特斯拉擁有開發自動駕駛技術的專長，主要以視覺為基礎的系統與軟體。[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #35]  
- 其 FSD 電腦負責運行車內神經網路，並正開發額外硬體以更好利用車輛收集的大量實地資料，持續訓練與改進神經網路以達到真實世界表現。[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #35]  
- 車輛提供 Autopilot 與 FSD（Supervised）兩種進階駕駛輔助選項。[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #35]  
- 特斯拉亦透過 OTA 軟體更新隨時間改進這些功能。[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #35]  
- 公司計畫於 2025 年開始推出 Robotaxi 服務，最終將以完全自動駕駛車輛營運的叫車網路。[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #35]  
- 特斯拉相信其 AI 能力，包括在得州 Gigafactory 部署的 Cortex 訓練叢集，使其區別於競爭對手。[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #35]  
- 此外，特斯拉將自動駕駛的 AI 學習應用於機器人領域，例如由同一 AI 系統控制的 Optimus 人形機器人。[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #35]

As AI infrastructure drives rapid load growth, Megapack helps to, among other things, increase utilization of existing generation and transmission capacity, resulting in a more efficient use of the electric grid. Automotive

Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence 

We use AI to develop real-world applications, such as autonomous driving solutions and robots. Energy Storage Products

We leverage many of the component-level technologies from our vehicles in our energy storage products. Additionally, our expertise in power electronics enables our battery systems to interconnect with electricity grids while providing fast-acting systems for power injection and absorption. We have also developed software to remotely control and dispatch our energy storage systems. Solar Energy Systems

We have engineered Solar Roof over numerous iterations to combine aesthetic appeal and durability with power generation. The efficiency of our solar energy products is aided by our own solar inverter, which incorporates our power electronics technologies. We designed both products to integrate with Powerwall. Design and Engineering

Automotive

We have established significant in-house capabilities in the design and test engineering of electric vehicles and their components and systems. records.query: Tesla 在電動車市場面臨什麼樣的競爭態勢？
records.answer:
Tesla 在電動車市場面臨著來自傳統車廠與新進競爭者的激烈競爭，包括混合動力、插電式混合動力及純電動車輛，以及自駕技術領域的競爭，這可能導致其銷量下降、價格壓力及市場份額流失。  

- Tesla 表示其未來成長與成功取決於消費者對電動車的需求，而汽車產業本身具競爭性、週期性且波動大。[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #70]  
- 全球汽車市場目前競爭激烈，且預計未來將更加激烈。[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #73]  
- 越來越多既有及新進汽車製造商以及其他公司已進入或計畫進入電動車及其他替代燃料車市場，包括混合動力、插電式混合動力及純電動車，亦涉及自駕技術及其他車輛應用與軟體平台。[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #73]  
- 許多競爭者擁有比 Tesla 更多或更完善的資源，可用於設計、開發、製造、分銷、推廣、銷售及支援其產品。[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #73]  
- 加劇的競爭可能導致 Tesla 的車輛單位銷售下降、價格下降、收入短缺、客戶流失及市場份額減少。[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #73]  
- Tesla 亦在能源產生與儲存業務上面臨其他製造商、開發商、安裝商、服務供應商及大型公用事業的競爭。[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #73]  
- 公用事業或其他再生能源的電價下降可能使 Tesla 的產品對客戶吸引力下降，並導致客戶違約率上升。[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #73]  
- Tesla 的車輛依據傳統車類別及動力技術競爭；例如 Cybertruck 與其他皮卡競爭，Model S 與 Model X 主要與高級轎車及 SUV 競爭，Model 3 與 Model Y 則與小至中型轎車及緊湊 SUV 競爭，所有這些市場皆極具競爭性。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #43]  
- 競爭產品通常包括來自較成熟車廠的內燃機車輛，但許多既有及新進車廠已進入或宣布計畫進入電動車及其他替代燃料車市場。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #43]  
- 許多主要車廠在美國、中國及歐洲等主要市場已提供電動車，其他車廠亦正在開發電動車；亦有多數車廠提供混合動力車，包括插電式版本。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #43]  
- 若自駕技術的接受率未如預期發展，Tesla 的業務、前景、財務狀況及經營結果可能受損。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59]  
- Tesla 面臨來自日益增多的既有及新進競爭者的強烈競爭。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59]  
- 全球汽車市場目前競爭激烈，且預計未來將更加激烈。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59]  
- 越來越多既有及新進汽車製造商以及其他公司已進入或計畫進入電動車及其他替代燃料車市場，包括混合動力、插電式混合動力及純電動車，亦涉及自駕技術及服務以及其他車輛應用與軟體平台。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59]  
- 某些政府及經濟激勵措施若有利於國內組裝或本地供應商，可能使競爭者獲得更大利益，進而負面影響 Tesla 的盈利能力。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59]  
- 許多競爭者擁有比 Tesla 更多或更完善的資源，可用於設計、開發、製造、分銷、推廣、銷售及支援其產品，並可能因地理位置及經濟環境獲得額外成本效益。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59]  
- 加劇的競爭可能導致 Tesla 的車輛單位銷售下降、價格下降、收入短缺、客戶流失及市場份額減少，進而損害其業務、財務狀況及經營結果。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59]  
- Tesla 亦在能源產生與儲存業務上面臨其他製造商、開發商、安裝商、服務供應商及大型公用事業的競爭。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59]  
- 公用事業或其他再生能源的電價下降可能使 Tesla 的產品對客戶吸引力下降，並導致客戶違約率上升。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59]  
- Tesla 的未來成長與成功依賴於其電動車的需求及自駕解決方案的採用；若電動車市場整體或 Tesla 車輛特別的需求未如預期發展、發展較慢、需求下降或車輛互相競爭，其業務、前景、財務狀況及經營結果可能受損。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #55]  
- 電動車仍僅佔整體車輛銷售的小部分；因此 Tesla 車輛的市場可能受到多種因素負面影響，包括對電動車特徵、品質、安全、性能及成本的感知；對單次充電續航里程有限及充電設施的感知；來自其他替代燃料車、插電式混合動力電動車及高燃油效率內燃機車的競爭；油價、汽油及能源成本的波動；政府規範及經濟激勵條件；以及對 Tesla 未來可行性的擔憂。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #55]  
- Tesla 的目標客群屬於高度競爭的市場。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #55]

Risks Related to Our Operations

We may experience issues with lithium-ion cells or other components manufactured at our Gigafactories, which may harm the production and profitability of our vehicle and energy storage products. Our plan to grow the volume and profitability of our vehicles and energy storage products depends on significant lithium-ion battery cell production, including by our partner Panasonic at Gigafactory Nevada. We also produce several vehicle components at our Gigafactories, such as battery modules and packs and drive units, and manufacture energy storage products. If we are unable to or otherwise do not maintain and grow our respective operations, or if we are unable to do so cost-effectively or hire and retain highly-skilled personnel there, our ability to manufacture our products profitably would be limited, which may harm our business and operating results. Finally, the high volumes of lithium-ion cells and battery modules and packs manufactured by us and by our suppliers are stored and recycled at our various facilities. Any mishandling of these products may cause disruption to the operation of such facilities. While we have implemented safety procedures related to the handling of the cells, there can be no assurance that a safety issue or fire related to the cells would not disrupt our operations. Any such disruptions or issues may harm our brand and business. We face risks associated with maintaining and expanding our international operations, including unfavorable and uncertain regulatory, political, economic, tax and labor conditions. We are subject to legal and regulatory requirements, political uncertainty and social, environmental and economic conditions in numerous jurisdictions, including markets in which we generate significant sales, over which we have little control and which are inherently unpredictable. Our operations in such jurisdictions, particularly as a company based in the U.S., with additional manufacturing operations in China and Europe, create risks relating to conforming our products to regulatory and safety requirements and charging and other electric infrastructures; organizing local operating entities; establishing, staffing and managing foreign business locations; attracting local customers; navigating foreign government taxes, regulations and permit requirements; enforceability of our contractual rights; trade restrictions, customs regulations, tariffs and price or exchange controls; and preferences in foreign nations for domestically manufactured products. For example, we monitor tax legislation changes on a global basis, including changes arising as a result of the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development’s multi-jurisdictional plan of action to address base erosion and profit shifting. Such conditions may increase our costs, impact our ability to sell our products and require significant management attention, and may harm our business if we are unable to manage them effectively.

records.query: Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務在公司整體策略中扮演什麼角色？
records.answer:
Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務是公司除汽車以外的另一個主要戰略支柱，負責提供整合的太陽能與儲能解決方案，同時利用車輛技術與 AI 基礎建設來推動清潔能源與自動駕駛的協同效應。  

- Tesla 同時經營兩大業務分部：汽車（Automotive）與能源生成與儲存（Energy Generation and Storage）[TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2]。  
- 能源業務負責設計、製造、安裝、銷售及租賃太陽能發電和儲能產品，並提供相關服務，面向住宅、商業、工業客戶及公用事業，透過公司網站、門市、畫廊以及通路夥伴銷售[TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2]。  
- 此外，能源業務還提供能源產品的維修與保固服務，以及對住宅客戶的各種融資方案[TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2]。  
- 產品線包括鋰離子電池儲能系統（Powerwall、Megapack）以及太陽能發電產品（太陽能板、Solar Roof）[TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2]。  
- 為提升電池能源密度與降低成本，Tesla 開發了新專有鋰離子電池細胞並改進製程[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]。  
- 能源儲存產品廣泛運用汽車的元件層級技術，並採用模組化電池系統設計以優化製造產能[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]。  
- 公司在功率電子方面的專長使電池系統能與電力互聯互通，提供快速的注入與吸收電力服務[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]。  
- Tesla 開發了遠端控制與調度能源儲存系統的軟體[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]。  
- 透過 AI 能力，每款儲能產品皆可透過韌體更新進行優化，特別是 Powerhub（分散式能源資源，含 Powerwall 虛擬電廠）與 Autobidder（Megapack 電池）平台[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]。  
- 2025 年開始製造新型住宅改造太陽能板，2026 年 1 月開始首批客戶交付；同時持續製造兼具美觀、耐用與發電效率的 Solar Roof[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]。  
- 太陽能產品的效率受益於自行開發的太陽能逆變器，該逆變器融合了功率電子技術[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]。  
- 太陽能板與儲能產品皆設計為可與 Powerwall 整合使用[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]。  
- 為支援清潔能源、運輸與自動機器人業務，Tesla 投資建置必要基礎設施，包括增加運算硬體以利用車輛蒐集的場景資料持續訓練與改進人工神經網路，以達到真實世界效能[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]。  
- 2025 年擴充了位於得州超級工廠的 Cortex 訓練叢集，並宣布與 Samsung 合作於美國製造先進半導體，用於 AI 推理與訓練[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]。  
- 目前正在建設 Cortex 2 以進一步提升 AI 訓練運算容量[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]。  
- 2026 年將在車輛、機器人（Bots）、能源儲存與電池製造六條新產線上提升產能，同時利用現有工廠、充電站與服務中心的佈局支援未來成長[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]。  
- 總體來說，Tesla 設計、開發、製造、租賃及銷售電動車與能源生成與儲存系統，業務覆蓋美國、中國及國際市場[TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1]。  

這些說明顯示，能源生成與儲能業務不僅是公司清潔能源願景的具體實踐，也是利用車輛技術、軟體與 AI 基礎建設來創造跨域協同效應、多元化收入來源並支援未來自動駕駛與機器人發展的重要戰略角色。

Energy Storage Products

We leverage many of the component-level technologies from our vehicles in our energy storage products. By taking a modular approach to the design of battery systems, we can optimize manufacturing capacity of our energy storage products. Additionally, our expertise in power electronics enables our battery systems to interconnect with electricity grids while providing fast-acting systems for power injection and absorption. We have also developed software to remotely control and dispatch our energy storage systems. Further leveraging our capabilities in AI, every Tesla energy storage product is capable of being enhanced through firmware updates and optimized by our software platforms, particularly Powerhub (for distributed energy resources, including Powerwall-enabled virtual power plants) and Autobidder (for Megapack batteries). Infrastructure

To support our businesses in clean energy and transport and autonomous robots, we are investing in and developing the necessary supporting infrastructure. records.query: Apple 自己在 10-K 中如何描述它在智慧型手機、PC、平板市場面臨的競爭壓力與市佔地位？
records.answer:
Apple 在 2025 年 10-K 中說明，智慧型手機、個人電腦和平板等產品市場競爭極為激烈，主要表現為激烈的價格競爭和毛利率下降壓力。[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #21]  
具體來說，該市場具有激烈的價格競爭、毛利率下降壓力、產品效能的持續提升、消費者與企業的價格敏感度、頻繁的新產品與服務推出、短產品生命週期、不斷演變的產業標準，以及競爭對手快速採用技術進步；許多競爭者透過激進定價、極低成本結構、模仿蘋果產品及侵害其智慧財產權來爭奪市場。[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #21]  
此外，蘋果自承在全球智慧型手機、個人電腦、平板與可穿戴設備市場中僅佔少數市場份額，且這些市場時常出現 weinig 成長甚至整體收縮的情況。[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #22]

[AAPL 10-K period 2025] The Company’s ability to compete successfully depends heavily on ensuring the continuing and timely introduction of innovative new products, services and technologies to the marketplace. The Company designs and develops nearly the entire solution for its products, including the hardware, operating system, numerous software applications and related services. Principal competitive factors important to the Company include price, product and service features (including security features), relative price and performance, product and service quality and reliability, design and technology innovation, a strong third-party software and accessories ecosystem, marketing and distribution capability, service and support, corporate reputation, and the ability to effectively protect and enforce the Company’s intellectual property rights. The Company is focused on expanding its market opportunities related to smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories, and services. The Company’s products and services face substantial competition from companies that have significant technical, marketing, distribution and other resources, as well as established hardware, software, and service offerings with large customer bases. In addition, the Company faces significant competition as competitors imitate the Company’s product features and applications within their products to offer more competitive solutions. The Company also expects competition to intensify as competitors imitate the Company’s approach to providing components seamlessly within their offerings or work collaboratively to offer integrated solutions. Some of the Company’s competitors have broad product lines, low-priced products, large installed bases of active devices, and large customer bases. Competition has been particularly intense as competitors have aggressively cut prices and lowered product margins. Certain competitors have the resources, experience or cost structures to provide products and services at little or no profit or even at a loss. The Company has a minority market share in the global smartphone, personal computer, tablet and wearables markets, and some of the markets in which the Company competes have from time to time experienced little to no growth or contracted overall. Supply of Components

[AAPL 10-K period 2025] Europe includes European countries, as well as India, the Middle East and Africa. Greater China includes China mainland, Hong Kong and Taiwan. Rest of Asia Pacific includes Australia, New Zealand and those Asian countries not included in the Company’s other reportable segments. Although the reportable segments provide similar hardware and software products and similar services, each one is managed separately to better align with the location of the Company’s customers and distribution partners and the unique market dynamics of each geographic region. Markets and Distribution

The Company’s customers are primarily in the consumer, small and mid-sized business, education, enterprise and government markets. The Company sells its products and resells third-party products in most of its major markets directly to customers through its retail and online stores and its direct sales force. The Company sells its services in the same markets through its various service platforms. The Company also employs a variety of indirect distribution channels, such as third-party cellular network carriers and other resellers, for the sale of its products and certain of its services. During 2025, the Company’s net sales through its direct and indirect distribution channels accounted for 40% and 60%, respectively, of total net sales. Competition

The markets for the Company’s products and services are highly competitive and are characterized by aggressive price competition, downward pressure on gross margins, continual improvement in product performance, and price sensitivity on the part of consumers and businesses. The markets in which the Company competes are further defined by frequent introduction of new products and services, short product life cycles, evolving industry standards, and rapid adoption of technological advancements by competitors. Many of the Company’s competitors seek to compete primarily through aggressive pricing and very low cost structures, and by imitating the Company’s products and infringing on its intellectual property. records.query: Apple 的第三方開發者生態系相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的黏著度是如何建立的？
records.answer:
Apple 的第三方開發者生態系的黏著度主要建立於開發者在評估在 Apple 平台開發、維護和升級軟體的相對效益時，會參考其市場地位、預期收入、未來增長及開發成本等因素，並與 Android、Windows 等競爭平台進行比較【AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41】。具體來說，開發者的決策依據包括：Apple 產品的市場位置、預期可產生的收入、未來產品銷售的增長預期以及開發成本【AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41】。由於 Apple 在全球智慧型手機、個人電腦和平板電腦市場的市場佔有率屬於少數，這使得開發者可能較不願意為 Apple 產品開發或升級軟體，而傾向將資源投入到市場佔有率較大的競爭平台（如 Android、Windows）上【AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41】。當開發者將精力集中在這些競爭平台時，Apple 裝置上的應用程式可用性和品質可能受到影響【AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41】。Apple 透過 App Store 分發第三方應用程式，絕大多數應用程式的收入由開發者全數保留，而 Apple 只在適用情況下從應用程式銷售及數位服務或商品中抽取佣金【AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41】。此外，Apple 為開發者提供工具和應用程式介面（API），並會因應訴訟、競爭、市場情況及法律監管要求（例如美國的替代購買機制、歐盟的數位市場法案）對產品和服務作出變更，以維持開發者生態系的吸引力【AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41】。Apple 也強調必須持續獲得具吸引力且具創新性的軟體應用程式，以維持其硬體產品的競爭力【AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41】。這些機制共同構成了 Apple 第三方開發者生態系相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的黏著度。

The Company’s ability to compete successfully depends heavily on ensuring the continuing and timely introduction of innovative new products, services and technologies to the marketplace. The Company designs and develops nearly the entire solution for its products, including the hardware, operating system, numerous software applications and related services. Principal competitive factors important to the Company include price, product and service features (including security features), relative price and performance, product and service quality and reliability, design innovation, a strong third-party software and accessories ecosystem, marketing and distribution capability, service and support, and corporate reputation. The Company is focused on expanding its market opportunities related to smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories, and services. The Company faces substantial competition in these markets from companies that have significant technical, marketing, distribution and other resources, as well as established hardware, software, and service offerings with large customer bases. In addition, some of the Company’s competitors have broader product lines, lower-priced products and a larger installed base of active devices. Competition has been particularly intense as competitors have aggressively cut prices and lowered product margins. Certain competitors have the resources, experience or cost structures to provide products at little or no profit or even at a loss. The Company’s services compete with business models that provide content to users for free and use illegitimate means to obtain third-party digital content and applications. The Company faces significant competition as competitors imitate the Company’s product features and applications within their products, or collaborate to offer integrated solutions that are more competitive than those they currently offer. Supply of Components

Although most components essential to the Company’s business are generally available from multiple sources, certain components are currently obtained from single or limited sources. The Company also competes for various components with other participants in the markets for smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories. Therefore, many components used by the Company, including those that are available from multiple sources, are at times subject to industry-wide shortage and significant commodity pricing fluctuations. The Company uses some custom components that are not commonly used by its competitors, and new products introduced by the Company often utilize custom components available from only one source. When a component or product uses new technologies, initial capacity constraints may exist until the suppliers’ yields have matured or their manufacturing capacities have increased. The continued availability of these components at acceptable prices, or at all, may be affected if suppliers decide to concentrate on the production of common components instead of components customized to meet the Company’s requirements. The Company has entered into agreements for the supply of many components; however, there can be no guarantee that the Company will be able to extend or renew these agreements on similar terms, or at all. Research and Development

Because the industries in which the Company competes are characterized by rapid technological advances, the Company’s ability to compete successfully depends heavily upon its ability to ensure a continual and timely flow of competitive products, services and technologies to the marketplace. The Company continues to develop new technologies to enhance existing products and services, and to expand the range of its offerings through research and development (“R&D”), licensing of intellectual property and acquisition of third-party businesses and technology. Intellectual Property

The Company currently holds a broad collection of intellectual property rights relating to certain aspects of its hardware devices, accessories, software and services. This includes patents, designs, copyrights, trademarks and other forms of intellectual property rights in the U.S. and various foreign countries. Although the Company believes the ownership of such intellectual property rights is an important factor in differentiating its business and that its success does depend in part on such ownership, the Company relies primarily on the innovative skills, technical competence and marketing abilities of its personnel. The Company regularly files patent, design, copyright and trademark applications to protect innovations arising from its research, development, design and marketing, and is currently pursuing thousands of applications around the world. Over time, the Company has accumulated a large portfolio of issued and registered intellectual property rights around the world. No single intellectual property right is solely responsible for protecting the Company’s products and services. The Company believes the duration of its intellectual property rights is adequate relative to the expected lives of its products and services. In addition to Company-owned intellectual property, many of the Company’s products and services are designed to include intellectual property owned by third parties. It may be necessary in the future to seek or renew licenses relating to various aspects of the Company’s products, processes and services. While the Company has generally been able to obtain such licenses on commercially reasonable terms in the past, there is no guarantee that such licenses could be obtained in the future on reasonable terms or at all.

The Company’s future performance depends in part on support from third-party software developers. The Company believes decisions by customers to purchase its hardware products depend in part on the availability of third-party software applications and services. There can be no assurance third-party developers will continue to develop and maintain software applications and services for the Company’s products. If third-party software applications and services cease to be developed and maintained for the Company’s products, customers may choose not to buy the Company’s products. The Company believes the availability of third-party software applications and services for its products depends in part on the developers’ perception and analysis of the relative benefits of developing, maintaining and upgrading such software and services for the Company’s products compared to competitors’ platforms, such as Android for smartphones and tablets, Windows for personal computers and tablets, and PlayStation, Nintendo and Xbox for gaming platforms. This analysis may be based on factors such as the market position of the Company and its products, the anticipated revenue that may be generated, expected future growth of product sales, and the costs of developing such applications and services. The Company’s minority market share in the global smartphone, personal computer and tablet markets can make developers less inclined to develop or upgrade software for the Company’s products and more inclined to devote their resources to developing and upgrading software for competitors’ products with larger market share. When developers focus their efforts on these competing platforms, the availability and quality of applications for the Company’s devices can suffer. The Company relies on the continued availability and development of compelling and innovative software applications for its products. The Company’s products and operating systems are subject to rapid technological change, and when third-party developers are unable to or choose not to keep up with this pace of change, their applications can fail to take advantage of these changes to deliver improved customer experiences, can operate incorrectly, and can result in dissatisfied customers and lower customer demand for the Company’s products. The Company distributes third-party applications for its products through the App Store. For the vast majority of applications, developers keep all of the revenue they generate on the App Store. Where applicable, the Company retains a commission from sales of applications and sales of digital services or goods initiated within an application. From time to time, the Company has made changes to its products and services, including taking actions in response to litigation, competition, market conditions and legal and regulatory requirements, and expects to make further business changes in the future. For example, in the U.S., the Company has implemented changes to how developers communicate with consumers within apps on the U.S. storefront of the iOS and iPadOS App Store regarding alternative purchasing mechanisms. The Company has also implemented changes to iOS, iPadOS, the App Store and Safari® in the European Union (“EU”) as it seeks to comply with the Digital Markets Act (the “DMA”), including new business terms and alternative fee structures for iOS and iPadOS apps, alternative methods of distribution for iOS and iPadOS apps, alternative payment processing for apps across the Company’s operating systems, and additional tools and application programming interfaces (“APIs”) for developers. Changes to the Company’s products and services could materially adversely affect the Company’s business, results of operations and financial condition, including if such business changes result in reduced App Store or other sales, reductions in the rate of the commission that the Company retains on such sales, or if the rate of the commission is otherwise narrowed in scope or eliminated.

Business Risks

To remain competitive and stimulate customer demand, the Company must successfully manage frequent introductions and transitions of products and services. Due to the highly volatile and competitive nature of the markets and industries in which the Company competes, the Company must continually introduce new products, services and technologies, enhance existing products and services, effectively stimulate customer demand for new and upgraded products and services, navigate global regulatory requirements and barriers to market access, and successfully manage the transition to these new and upgraded products and services. The success of new product and service introductions depends on a number of factors, including the Company’s ability to recruit and retain highly skilled personnel to execute on its strategic initiatives, and the timely and successful development and market acceptance of new products, services and technologies. Success also relies on the Company’s ability to manage the risks associated with new technologies and production ramp-up issues, the effective integration of third-party services and technologies into the Company’s products and services, the availability, delivery and performance of application software or other third-party support for the Company’s products and services, the effective management of manufacturing and other purchase commitments and the management of inventory levels in line with anticipated product demand, and the availability of products in appropriate quantities and at expected costs to meet anticipated demand. Additionally, quality issues or other defects or deficiencies can adversely affect the success of new product and service introductions and market acceptance. New products, services and technologies may replace or supersede existing offerings and may produce lower revenues and lower profit margins. The Company may not be able to successfully manage future introductions and transitions of products and services, which can materially adversely affect the Company’s business, reputation, results of operations, financial condition and stock price. The Company depends on component and product manufacturing and logistical services provided by outsourcing partners, many of which are located outside of the U.S. A significant majority of the Company’s manufacturing is performed in whole or in part by outsourcing partners located primarily in China mainland, India, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Vietnam, in addition to sourcing from partners and facilities located in the U.S. The Company relies on single-source partners in the U.S., Asia and Europe to supply and manufacture many components, and on partners primarily located in Asia, for final assembly of substantially all of the Company’s hardware products. The Company has also outsourced much of its transportation and logistics management.

While these arrangements can lower operating costs, they also reduce the Company’s direct control over production and distribution.

Competition

Azure faces diverse competition from cloud service providers and open-source offerings. Azure’s competitive advantage includes enabling a hybrid cloud, allowing deployment of existing datacenters with our public cloud into a single, cohesive infrastructure, and the ability to run at a scale that meets the needs of businesses of all sizes and complexities. Our AI offerings compete with AI products from hyperscalers, as well as products from other emerging competitors and other open-source offerings, many of which are also current or potential partners. Our Azure Security offerings include our cloud security solution and our security information and event management solution, which compete with providers in the cybersecurity and cloud security space. We believe our cloud’s global scale, coupled with our broad portfolio of identity and security solutions, allows us to effectively solve complex cybersecurity challenges for our customers and differentiates us from the competition. Our server products face competition from a wide variety of server operating systems and applications offered by companies with a range of market approaches. Vertically integrated computer manufacturers offer their own versions of the Unix operating system preinstalled on server hardware and nearly all computer manufacturers offer server hardware for the Linux operating system. We compete to provide enterprise-wide computing and point solutions with numerous commercial software vendors that offer solutions and middleware technology platforms, software applications for connectivity, security, hosting, database, and e-business servers. Our database, business intelligence, and data warehousing solutions offerings compete with products from providers in the data and analytics industry. Our system management solutions compete with server management and server virtualization platform providers. Our products for software developers compete against offerings from major technology providers, as well as open-source alternatives. We believe our server products provide customers with advantages in performance, total costs of ownership, and productivity by delivering superior applications, development tools, compatibility with a broad base of hardware and software applications, security, and manageability. Our Enterprise and partner services business competes with a wide range of companies that provide strategy and business planning, application development, and infrastructure services, including multinational consulting firms and small niche businesses focused on specific technologies. More Personal Computing

Our More Personal Computing segment consists of products and services that put customers at the center of the experience with our technology. This segment primarily comprises:

•Windows and Devices, including Windows OEM licensing (Windows Pro and non-Pro licenses sold through the OEM channel) and Devices, comprising Surface and PC accessories. •XBOX (formerly Gaming), including XBOX hardware and XBOX content and services, comprising first- and third-party content (including games and in-game content), XBOX Game Pass and other subscriptions, XBOX Cloud Gaming, advertising, and other cloud services. •Search advertising (formerly Search and news advertising), comprising Bing, Copilot, Microsoft News, Microsoft Edge, and third-party affiliates. Windows and Devices

The Windows operating system is designed to deliver a more personal computing experience for users by enabling consistency of experience, applications, and information across their devices. Windows OEM revenue is impacted significantly by the number of Windows operating system licenses purchased by OEMs, which they pre-install on the devices they sell. In addition to computing device market volume, Windows OEM revenue is impacted by: 

•The mix of computing devices based on form factor and screen size. •Differences in device market demand between developed markets and growth markets. •Growth of the AI PC category. •Attachment of Windows to devices shipped. •Customer mix between consumer, small and medium businesses, and large enterprises. •Changes in inventory levels in the OEM channel. •Pricing changes and promotions, pricing variation that occurs when the mix of devices manufactured shifts from local and regional system builders to large multinational OEMs, and different pricing of Windows versions licensed. •Constraints in the supply chain of device components.

DISTRIBUTION, SALES, AND MARKETING 

Distribution occurs through a combination of direct and indirect channels. Direct sales activities serve customers ranging from large multinational enterprises and public sector organizations to small and medium-sized businesses. Indirect sales activities serve customers through a broad network of partners that support the sale, deployment, and management of Microsoft products and services worldwide. The indirect channel extends the reach of commercial offerings and supports customers across industries, geographies, and organization sizes. Sales and distribution models continue to evolve to support cloud-based, subscription-based, and consumption-based offerings while maintaining multiple options through which customers may acquire and manage our products and services. OEMs license and preinstall certain Microsoft software on devices that are sold to end customers. In addition, certain products and services are available through online purchasing channels and digital marketplaces. LICENSING OPTIONS

[GOOGL 10-Q period 202603] We expense legal fees in the period in which they are incurred. Antitrust Matters

We are subject to formal and informal inquiries and investigations as well as litigation on various competition matters by regulatory authorities and private parties in the US, Europe, and other jurisdictions globally, including the following:

•Android: In July 2018, the European Commission (EC) announced its decision that certain provisions in Google's Android-related distribution agreements infringed European antitrust laws, imposed a €4.3 billion fine, and directed the termination of the conduct at issue. We appealed the EC decision and implemented changes to certain of our Android distribution practices. In September 2022, the General Court affirmed the EC decision but reduced the fine from €4.3 billion to €4.1 billion. We subsequently appealed the General Court's affirmation of the EC decision with the European Court of Justice, which remains pending. In 2018, we recognized a charge of $5.1 billion for the fine, which we reduced by $217 million in 2022. •AdSense for Search: In March 2019, the EC announced its decision that certain provisions in Google's agreements with AdSense for Search partners infringed European antitrust laws, imposed a €1.5 billion fine, and directed actions related to AdSense for Search partners' agreements, which we implemented prior to the decision. In 2019, we recognized a charge of $1.7 billion for the fine and appealed the EC decision. In September 2024, the General Court overturned the EC decision and annulled the €1.5 billion fine. The EC has appealed the General Court's decision with the European Court of Justice, which remains pending. 27

•Search: In October 2020, the US Department of Justice (DOJ) and a number of state Attorneys General filed a lawsuit in the US District Court for the District of Columbia concerning Google's Search and Search advertising practices and its compliance with US antitrust laws. In August 2024, the US District Court for the District of Columbia ruled against Google. A final judgment was entered in December 2025, which, among other things, imposes restrictions on how Google distributes its services and requires Google to share certain search data with and offer syndication services to certain competitors. In January 2026, we appealed the final judgment and moved to pause implementation of certain remedies. Foreign Exchange Risk

During Q2 2026, net sales from our International segment accounted for 21% of our consolidated revenues. Net sales and related expenses generated from our internationally-focused stores, including within Canada and Mexico (which are included in our North America segment), are primarily denominated in the functional currencies of the corresponding stores and primarily include Euros, British Pounds, and Japanese Yen. The results of operations of, and certain of our intercompany balances associated with, our internationally-focused stores and AWS are exposed to foreign exchange rate fluctuations. Upon consolidation, as foreign exchange rates vary, net sales and other operating results may differ materially from expectations, and we may record significant gains or losses on the remeasurement of intercompany balances. For example, as a result of fluctuations in foreign exchange rates throughout the period compared to rates in effect the prior year, International segment net sales in Q2 2026 decreased by $82 million in comparison with Q2 2025. We have foreign exchange risk related to foreign-denominated cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities (“foreign funds”). Based on the balance of foreign funds as of June 30, 2026, of $20.4 billion, an assumed 5%, 10%, and 20% adverse change to foreign exchange rates would result in declines of $1.0 billion, $2.0 billion, and $4.1 billion. We also have foreign exchange risk related to our intercompany balances denominated in various currencies. Based on the intercompany balances as of June 30, 2026, an assumed 5%, 10%, and 20% adverse change to foreign exchange rates would result in losses of $400 million, $795 million, and $1.6 billion, recorded to “Other income (expense), net.”

Our foreign currency-denominated unsecured senior notes create exposure to changes in foreign exchange rates. As of June 30, 2026, we have designated $20.7 billion of our Euro- and Canadian Dollar-denominated Notes as net investment hedges to mitigate foreign currency exposures related to the translation of our investments in foreign operations to U.S. dollars.

records.query: NVIDIA 這一季在中國市場的資料中心晶片出貨狀況如何？跟去年同期相比有何變化？
records.answer:
在2025年第一季（截至2025年4月27日），NVIDIA 在中國市場的資料中心晶片出貨（以H20產品計）原本約為46億美元，但隨著美國政府於同年4月9日發布的新出口許可證要求，該季度因而產生45億美元的庫存撥備，顯示出貨急劇下降。  

具體來看，該季度在許可證要求生效前，H20產品的銷售額為46億美元[NVDA_10Q_202504.html, chunk #44]，但在美國政府宣布需要對中國（含香港、澳門）及D:5國家出口H20等產品申請許可證後，NVIDIA 因H20庫存過剩及採購義務而在同一季度計提了45億美元的撥備，原因是H20產品需求明顯減少[NVDA_10Q_202504.html, chunk #44]。公司亦指出，這項出口管制將對當前收入產生負面影響，並將繼續影響未來營收[NVDA_10Q_202504.html, chunk #44]。  

至於與去年同期的比較，雖然資料未直接披露中國市場的資料中心晶片出貨金額，但整體資料中心業務在該季度的收入為391.12 億美元（$39,112 百萬），而去年同期（2024年第一季）為225.63 億美元（$22,563 百萬），年增約73%[NVDA_10Q_202504.html, chunk #37]。這表明雖然總體資料中心收入顯著成長，但中國市場的出貨卻因出口管制而受到嚴重抑制；更進一步顯示，截至2026年第一季（即2027財年第一季）末，NVIDIA 雖仍能將不受管制的產品（如遊戲與工作站GPU）出售給中國，但在中國的資料中心運算市場已被實質性地排除在外[NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #84]。綜合以上資料可見，與去年同期相比，NVIDIA 在中國市場的資料中心晶片出貨在該季度出現了急遽下降的情況。

[NVDA 10-Q period 202504] [section: Recent Developments, Future Objectives and Challenges] On April 9, 2025, the U.S. government, or USG, informed us that it requires a license for export to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and D:5 countries, or to companies headquartered or with an ultimate parent therein, of our H20 integrated circuits and any other circuits achieving the H20’s memory bandwidth, interconnect bandwidth, or combination thereof. As a result of these new requirements, we incurred a $4.5 billion charge in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 associated with H20 excess inventory and purchase obligations as the demand for H20 products diminished. The $4.5 billion charge was less than what we initially anticipated as we were able to re-use certain materials. Sales of our H20 products were $4.6 billion for the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 prior to the new export licensing requirements. The H20 export licensing requirements have impacted our current revenue and will also negatively affect our future revenue. We are still evaluating our limited options to supply Data Center compute products compliant with the USG’s export control rules. The export controls applicable to China are complex and address a variety of parameters, including the total processing performance of a chip, the “performance density” of a chip, the interconnect bandwidth of a chip, and the memory bandwidth of a chip. We may be unable to create a competitive product for China’s data center market that receives approval from the USG. In that event, we would effectively be foreclosed from competing in China's data center computing/compute market, with a material and adverse impact on our business, operating results, and financial condition. 22

We believe the China AI market to be a significant opportunity and the existing and new export controls will greatly hinder our ability to address this opportunity and will continue to impact our revenue and operational results. We continue to execute Data Center compute product introductions, bringing new advanced architectures on a one-year product cadence. We expect to begin shipping samples and production units of our new Blackwell Ultra platforms in the second quarter of fiscal year 2026. Our product transitions and sophisticated system configurations may create challenges in managing supply and demand.

The current tariff regime will have a relatively larger impact on our energy generation and storage business compared to our automotive business. We have continued to expand and refine our Robotaxi service after its June 2025 launch, capitalizing on our AI investments and scalable mobility infrastructure to advance a service-driven business model. records.query: 亞馬遜最近在 AI 這塊砸錢做了什麼？跟哪家 AI 公司搭上線？
records.answer:
亞馬遜最近已向 OpenAI 投資約 287 億美元（$28.7 billion）的系列 C 優先股（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日），並與其合作提供 AWS 雲端服務與模型，同時也持有 Anthropic 的非投票優先股。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40]  

在 2026 年第一季，亞馬遜投資 15.0 億美元購買 OpenAI 系列 C 優先股，並簽署商業安排以提供 AWS 雲端服務（包括使用與效能的 AWS 晶片）以及共同合作協議，讓 OpenAI 模型在 AWS 上提供服務。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40]  

在 2026 年第二季，亞馬遜進一步投資 137 億美元（$13.7 billion）的承諾金額購買 OpenAI 系列 C 優先股，使得截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的累計投資達到 287 億美元（$28.7 billion），並將剩餘承諾金額列為私人公司股權投資（非權益法）的一部分。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40]  

其後，亞馬遜在 2026 年 6 月 30 日後投資了剩餘的 213 億美元（$21.3 billion）承諾金額購買 OpenAI 系列 C 優先股。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40]  

截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日及 2026 年 6 月 30 日，亞馬遜於非權益法私人公司股權投資（主要為 Anthropic 非投票優先股及 OpenAI 優先股）的賬面價值分別為 162 億美元（$16.2 billion）及 1,223 億美元（$122.3 billion）。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40]  

同時，權益法投資（包括採用公平價值選擇的投資）賬面價值為 2025 年 12 月 31 日 6.59 億美元，2026 年 6 月 30 日 3.95 億美元。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40]  

亞馬遜持有的其他公司股權證公平價值為 2025 年 12 月 31 日 27 億美元（$2.7 billion），2026 年 6 月 30 日 43 億美元（$4.3 billion），收益與損失於「其他收入（支出），淨額」中認列。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40]

Large language models have made it possible to express more natural language queries, vastly improving the types of questions users can ask, and the quality of results. Each advancement has made it easier and more natural for people to find what they are looking for. We are now using Gemini customized for Google Search to provide our users an improved Search experience, and AI Overviews has been released in more than one hundred countries, reaching more than one billion users. This drive to make information more accessible and helpful has led us over the years to improve the discovery and creation of digital content both on the web and through platforms like Google Play and YouTube. People are consuming many forms of digital content, including watching videos, streaming TV, playing games, listening to music, 

6. Alphabet Inc. reading books, and using apps. Working with content creators and partners, we continue to build new ways for people around the world to create and find great digital content. Fueling all of these great digital experiences are extraordinary platforms and devices. That is why we continue to invest in platforms like our Android mobile operating system, Chrome browser, and Chrome operating system, as well as our family of devices. We see tremendous potential for devices to be helpful and make people's lives easier by combining the best of our AI, software, and hardware. records.query: Meta 搞的那些 VR 眼鏡跟 AI，到底想往哪個方向發展？
records.answer:
Meta 正把 VR 眼鏡與 AI 結合，朝著建構下一代運算平台（即所謂的 metaverse）並將 AI 助理嵌入可穿戴裝置的方向發展，例如預計將約 50% 的 Reality Labs 營運費用用於穿戴式產品（如 AI 眼鏡與 AR 眼鏡），另約 50% 用於較廣泛的 metaverse 相關研發[META_10K_2024.html, chunk #24]。具體來說，Meta 正透過以下方式推進：

- 以「建構人類未來的連線方式」為使命，產品涵蓋行動裝置、個人電腦、VR 頭戴裝置與 AI 眼鏡，並持續在人工智慧上投資，以打造橫跨 Family of Apps 與新平台的變革體驗，並朝著提供「個人超級智慧」（超越人類智慧的 AI）的願景前進[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22]。  
- 將產品從傳統的 2D 螢幕轉向沉浸式的擴增實境（AR）與虛擬實境（VR）體驗，以協助打造下一代運算平台，而其願景不聚焦於單一產品，而是構建由體驗、裝置與新技術組成、以 AI 為驅動的完整生態系統[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22]。  
- 雖然 metaverse 仍處於早期階段，但 Meta 相信它將成為未來的運算平台與社交互動的主要形式[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22]。  
- 在 VR 方面，Meta 目前提供 Meta Quest 裝置以及透過 Meta Horizon Store 取得的軟體與內容，讓使用者能在遊戲、健身、娛樂等社交體驗中突破物理距離[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25]。為提升 VR 的接受度，Meta 在 Quest 裝置上加入了「passthrough」混合實境功能，讓使用者在體驗沉浸感的同時仍能感知實體環境[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25]。  
- 可穿戴領域則聚焦於 AI 眼鏡與長期的 AR 研究。目前的 AI 眼鏡包括 Ray‑Ban Meta 與 Oakley Meta 眼鏡，內建 Meta AI（先進的對話式助理）並支援免手勢操作[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25]。為了讓 AR 眼鏡走向市場，Meta 在 2024 年發表了 Orion 原型——一款真正的 AR 眼鏡，能將虛擬內疊加到實體世界，具備業界領先的視野與適合長時間佩戴的眼鏡形狀[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25]。2025 年又推出 Meta Ray‑Ban Display，將 AI 眼鏡與鏡片內建的顯示器結合，並配備 Meta Neural Band（腕部穿戴式裝置，利用肌電訊號讓使用者透過神經肌肉訊號控制 AI 眼鏡）[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25]。  
- 除了硬體，Meta 也在探索利用肌電訊號的神介面（neural interfaces）以及結合 AI 與硬體的下一代介面技術，以支援長遠的運算平台願景[META_10K_2024.html, chunk #24]。  
- 在 AI 投資方面，Meta 正大力發展生成式 AI 與超級智慧模型，以透過 AI 驅動的發現引擎推薦相關內容、提升廣告工具的投放、定位與效果測量能力，並開發新產品與現有產品的新功能[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #29]。公司亦有開放原始碼的傳統（如釋出 Llama 基礎模型），並相信透過開放原始碼可以加速 AI 研究、改善產品並促進科技社群創新[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #29]。  
- Meta 會定期檢視產品路線圖，依技術挑戰、市場環境以及產品構想的演變做出重大調整，以確保投資方向與實際需求同步[META_10K_2024.html, chunk #24][META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165]。  
- 由於 Reality Labs 的投資需要依賴其他業務的盈餘來支撐，Meta 預計將持續在 VR、AR 及其他相關技術上進行重大投資，同時也可能面臨法規、互通性與競爭等風險[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165]。  

綜上所述，Meta 的 VR 眼鏡與 AI 發展方向是：利用沉浸式 VR/MR 體驗與可穿戴 AI/AR 裝置（如 Quest、Ray‑Ban Meta AI 眼鏡、Orion 原型、Meta Ray‑Ban Display 及 Neural Band）建構下一代運算平台；同時透過 AI 投資（生成式 AI、超級智慧模型、開放原始碼）提升內容推薦、廣告效能與產品創新；並將約一半的 Reality Labs 經費分配給穿戴式產品，另一半用於較廣泛的 metaverse 相關長期研發[META_10K_2024.html, chunk #24]。

[META 10-K period 2024] •WhatsApp. WhatsApp is a simple, reliable, and secure messaging application that is used by people and businesses around the world to communicate and transact in a private way. Reality Labs Products

Many of our Reality Labs investments are directed toward long-term, cutting edge research and development for products that are not on the market today and may only be fully realized in the next decade. This includes exploring new technologies such as neural interfaces using electromyography, which lets people control their devices using neuromuscular signals, as well as innovations in AI and hardware to help build next-generation interfaces. In the near term, we are continuing to develop early metaverse and wearables products and experiences that help people feel connected, anytime, anywhere. Our metaverse efforts include our VR, MR, and social platform initiatives. Our current product offerings in VR include our Meta Quest devices, as well as software and content available through the Meta Horizon Store, which enable a range of social experiences that allow people to defy physical distance while engaging in gaming, fitness, entertainment, and more. To drive greater adoption and acceptance of VR we have introduced MR capabilities, which allow users to experience the immersion and presence of VR while still being grounded in the physical world, through our Meta Quest devices. Our wearables efforts include our AR initiatives. We have continued to advance our roadmap to include additional AI-enabled offerings such as the Ray-Ban Meta AI glasses, which feature Meta AI, our advanced conversational assistant, as well as other features such as hands-free interaction. As we continue our long-term efforts to bring AR glasses to market, in 2024 we also unveiled our Orion prototype, a pair of true AR glasses that overlay content on top of the physical world. It does this with an industry-leading field of view and in glasses form factor for comfortable wear. In general, while all of these investments are part of our long-term initiative to help build the next computing platform, our metaverse efforts also include notable shorter-term projects developing specific products and services to go to market, whereas our wearables efforts are primarily directed toward longer-term research and development projects. For example, in 2025, we expect to spend approximately 50% of our Reality Labs operating expenses on our wearables initiatives, and the remaining 50% on our metaverse initiatives. We apply significant judgment in estimating this expense breakdown as there are certain shared costs across product lines, and our expectations are subject to change, including as the next computing platform and our business strategies evolve. In particular, we regularly evaluate our product roadmaps and make significant changes as our understanding of the technological challenges and market landscape and our product ideas and designs evolve. In addition, as our Reality Labs efforts evolve, we may be subject to a variety of existing or new laws and regulations in the United States and international jurisdictions, including in the areas of privacy, safety, AI, competition, content regulation, medical devices, tariffs, export controls, consumer protection, and e-commerce, which may delay or impede the development of our products and services, increase our operating costs, require significant management time and attention, or otherwise harm our business. 65


As a result of these or other factors, our Reality Labs strategy and investments may not be successful in the foreseeable future, or at all, which could adversely affect our business, reputation, or financial results. If we are not able to maintain and enhance our brands, our ability to maintain or expand our base of users, marketers, and developers may be impaired, and our business and financial results may be harmed.
